blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Oral arguments tackling the conviction threshold in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial took an unexpected emotional turn after the status and charges of detained senators were alluded to during the proceedings, prompting one of the senator-judges to break down in tears. This was during the senator-judges’ interpolations when Senator-judge Erwin Tulfo—who was arguing in favor of reducing the threshold—pointed out prevailing “factual circumstances” in Duterte’s trial, specifically how some senators simply cannot participate in it.
